scope: v1.3 public line input and frame pacing for Workbench and standalone Ship Runtime

public_surface.key-event: (key-event [mode]) returns nil or (key code modifiers); mode 0 polls and mode 1 blocks
public_surface.read-line: (read-line) edits and echoes one bounded line, then returns a packed string
public_surface.wait: (wait frames) blocks for a bounded raster-frame duration and returns nil

input.limit_policy: ignore further printable input while retaining DEL, RETURN and RUN/STOP
input.echo: Bank-2 Lisp owns a one-row tail viewport on the final screen row; accepted printable bytes appear once, DEL erases one accepted byte, and RETURN emits one native newline

screen_viewport.long_line_policy: show the newest screen-width characters without changing the 250-character logical limit

input.run_stop: RUN/STOP is never coalesced or returned; the existing input abort boundary always wins

wait.run_stop: the standing VM lisp_poll cadence aborts every wait loop

placement.screen_driver_support: read-line consumes only the already-public screen-size and screen-put-char primitives; DEL has no scr_putc/scr_backspace edge
placement.screen_driver_geometry_rule: the pre-freight C screen driver is byte-for-byte source-restored in both product build paths; the archived 105-byte non-LTO leaf remains unlinked shelf evidence
placement.ship_runtime_profile_note: standalone images bind the already public key-event/write-char/peek primitives to their physical Runtime drivers; that Runtime-only code is measured separately from Workbench resident geometry

execution_lanes: source-compiled P0 VM with queued key events and sequenced frame reads
emitted-artifact P0 VM with the same independent screen fixtures
mutation_families: wrong screen cell for printable echo
native cursor or C DEL dependency reintroduced
copying reverse at RETURN instead of consuming the owned chain
wrong frame byte or non-atomic reader

claim_limit: Host source/artifact semantics and capacity until the joint WPLTO card and quiet hardware session.
